answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a formal notation where applicable, precise language register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the nadir of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the anchor re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on homomorphic encryption for private computation. By the sonnet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
